title: All day: NY midday 11:00-13:30 - cont (H1 pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: start trading 24/7 - which setups work in each part of the NQ day, at the same or a higher win rate than LIT?
notes: tools/allday.py, variant cont|ny_mid|sofar,0.65,0.25|R1.5,None,w; picked: H1 pick (2026 Jan-Jun, win % >= 50, plateau score)

rules: The trading day so far moved one way: |close - open| >= 0.65 x its range, range >= 0.15 x the 14-day mean daily range.
Pullback >= 0.25 x that range from the move's extreme, then a 5m close beyond the prior candle's high (long) / low (short), with the move.
Stop 1 tick beyond the pullback extreme; the setup's own level = the move's extreme.
Time exit: flat at the window end + 60 min. One trade a day. Entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop and time exits - 1 tick; $1.40 a micro.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); stops 6-80 pts.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
